test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

My mother's sister __work since eight__ hours every weekday.
solution:
The correct answer is **works for eight**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The use of **for** is more appropriate here instead of **since**.
 
• The word 'for' is used to show a
